title: Insulin Pump Program Returns Accounting Note: Returned Units on a Denied Line
content:
For a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program, returned units of the denied line follow the line's return records:

1. Where a corrected claim for the line has been transmitted, the cash price of the units it no longer bills — the original claim's billed amount less the corrected claim's, times the line's units, divided by the original claim's billed amount, rounded to a whole unit — is taken off the charge.
2. Where no corrected claim is on file but the warehouse has received unopened units of the line back, the cash price of those received units is taken off the charge.
3. Otherwise nothing is taken off.

## Worked cases (hypothetical A4225 line of 40 units, cash price $6.85)

| Return records | Units no longer billed or received | Taken off the charge |
|---|---|---|
| Original claim billed $400.00; corrected claim billed $300.00 | 100 times 40 is 4,000; divided by 400 is 10 | $68.50 |
| No corrected claim; warehouse received 6 unopened units back | 6 | $41.10 |
| Neither | — | nothing |

A corrected claim decides the count even when the warehouse has also received units back.
